demo.summaryDesc: The demo flow has completed. Here is an overview.
demo.openRealProjectDesc: Select your project directory. ShuJi will automatically plan and execute tasks based on requirements.
demo.switchApprovalMode: to switch approval mode and let the system wait for your confirmation at key nodes.
demo.tourDutyBar: Duty Bar — view real-time activity from each ministry
demo.tourDecision: Decision — imperial review and approval of documents
demo.tourDocuments: Documents — design docs, contracts, and reports
demo.tourAllQuiet: All Quiet — no active ministry tasks
demo.tourMockDesc1: The duty bar at the bottom shows real-time activity of all departments. In offline demo mode, the system simulates the conversation flow of each department, giving you an intuitive feel for how ShuJi works.
demo.tourMockDesc2: The central area shows the conversation between the Emperor (you) and all departments. In offline demo mode, the system follows a preset script to demonstrate the complete task assignment and execution process.
demo.tourMockDesc3: Clicking document references opens the artifacts panel on the right, where you can view various design, review, and other documents in an organized archive.
demo.tourMockDesc4: After the demo ends, you will see a complete execution overview. Click "Open Real Project" to start using ShuJi for actual development.
demo.tourDesc1: The duty bar at the bottom shows real-time activity of all departments. Lit departments indicate ongoing tasks so you can track progress at a glance.
demo.tourDesc2: Click document references in the artifact panel or activity feed to preview corresponding documents. You can also click the "Files" icon in the activity bar to browse all documents.
demo.tourDesc3: Gongbu Shangshu is fixing a bug in calc.py. You can see Gongbu active in the duty bar, real-time department actions in the main activity feed, and documents displayed on demand in the artifact panel.
demo.tourDesc4: Xingbu Shangshu will test and verify the fix. Once all checks pass, the duty bar will show "All Quiet" — completing a full demo flow.
demo.demoMessage: Fix the bug in the power() and factorial() functions in calc.py, and ensure all tests pass.

helpDrawer.title: System Help
helpDrawer.beginnerHint: Shows chat, flow summary, and pending docs by default. Expand ▾ at the sidebar bottom for audit, checkpoints, flow graph, etc.
helpDrawer.advancedHint: Shows department cards and all sidebar tools.
helpDrawer.tip1: Type /level-1 to /level-3 to control engagement level
helpDrawer.tip2: Discussion tab is for chat only — no code changes
helpDrawer.tip3: Key nodes require imperial document approval
helpDrawer.tip4: Click "Stop All Ministries" to halt processing anytime
helpDrawer.tip5: Sidebar lets you browse all .shuji documents
helpDrawer.tip6: System auto-selects workflow based on requirements; you can also specify a skill name manually

helpWorkflow.desc4: View design document, approve or reject in the preview area
helpWorkflow.desc5: Division of labor: detailed design → testing → coding → verification → standards

approval.bannerPaused: The review report is ready. Approve it to continue the pipeline.
approval.notSatisfiedHint: If you disagree with the review: stop all departments, restore a checkpoint, and issue a new command — do not use reject.
approval.whyReview: The reviewer has finished. Confirm the design and risks before execution.
approval.whyDesign: The designer has finished. Confirm the design direction before review or execution.
approval.whyPlan: The pipeline plan is ready. Confirm execution steps before dispatching departments.
approval.whyDefault: A key document is ready. Approve it to continue the workflow.
approval.rejectConsequence: If you do not approve: click Stop all departments, restore a checkpoint, and issue a revised command.

step1.title: Step 1: Issue an edict
step1.body: Describe your task in the input at the bottom and click Send. The Cabinet submits a Pipeline plan.
step1.hint: Try an example edict from the project overview.

step2.title: Step 2: Approve documents
step2.body: When a review/plan is ready, an approval banner appears. Preview in Artifact panel and click Approve.
step2.hint: Pending docs show a gold dot on the Files sidebar icon.

step3.title: Step 3: See results
step3.body: CommandBar shows step progress. After completion, check delivery validation and latest documents.
step3.hint: Hover ? or dotted terms in the UI for glossary hints.
